record.bible_text: When thou goest out<WH03318><WTH8799> to battle<WH04421> against thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and seest<WH07200><WTH8804> horses<WH05483>, and chariots<WH07393>, <FI>and<Fi> a people<WH05971> more<WH07227> than thou, be not afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of them: for the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> with thee, which brought thee up<WH05927><WTH8688> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.
And it shall be, when ye are come nigh<WH07126><WTH8800> unto the battle<WH04421>, that the priest<WH03548> shall approach<WH05066><WTH8738> and speak<WH01696><WTH8765> unto the people<WH05971>,

For the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> he that goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> with you, to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> for you against your enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, to save<WH03467><WTH8687> you.

And the officers<WH07860><WTH8802> shall speak<WH01696><WTH8765> unto the people<WH05971>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, What man<WH0376> <FI>is there<Fi> that hath built<WH01129><WTH8804> a new<WH02319> house<WH01004>, and hath not dedicated<WH02596><WTH8804> it? let him go<WH03212><WTH8799> and return<WH07725><WTH8799> to his house<WH01004>, lest he die<WH04191><WTH8799> in the battle<WH04421>, and another<WH0312> man<WH0376> dedicate<WH02596><WTH8799> it.

And what man<WH0376> <FI>is he<Fi> that hath planted<WH05193><WTH8804> a vineyard<WH03754>, and hath not <FI>yet<Fi> eaten<WH02490><WTH8765> of it? let him <FI>also<Fi> go<WH03212><WTH8799> and return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto his house<WH01004>, lest he die<WH04191><WTH8799> in the battle<WH04421>, and another<WH0312> man<WH0376> eat<WH02490><WTH8762> of it. <RF>eaten...: Heb. made it common<Rf>

And what man<WH0376> <FI>is there<Fi> that hath betrothed<WH0781><WTH8765> a wife<WH0802>, and hath not taken<WH03947><WTH8804> her? let him go<WH03212><WTH8799> and return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto his house<WH01004>, lest he die<WH04191><WTH8799> in the battle<WH04421>, and another<WH0312> man<WH0376> take<WH03947><WTH8799> her.

And the officers<WH07860><WTH8802> shall speak<WH01696><WTH8763> further<WH03254><WTH8804> unto the people<WH05971>, and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8804>, What man<WH0376> <FI>is there that is<Fi> fearful<WH03373> and fainthearted<WH07390><WH03824>? let him go<WH03212><WTH8799> and return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto his house<WH01004>, lest his brethren's<WH0251> heart<WH03824> faint<WH04549><WTH8735> as well as his heart<WH03824>. <RF>faint: Heb. melt<Rf>

And it shall be, when the officers<WH07860><WTH8802> have made an end<WH03615><WTH8763> of speaking<WH01696><WTH8763> unto the people<WH05971>, that they shall make<WH06485><WTH8804> captains<WH08269> of the armies<WH06635> to lead<WH07218> the people<WH05971>. <RF>to lead...: Heb. to be in the head of the people<Rf><CM>
When thou comest nigh<WH07126><WTH8799> unto a city<WH05892> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> against it, then proclaim<WH07121><WTH8804> peace<WH07965> unto it.

And it shall be, if it make thee answer<WH06030><WTH8799> of peace<WH07965>, and open<WH06605><WTH8804> unto thee, then it shall be, <FI>that<Fi> all the people<WH05971> <FI>that is<Fi> found<WH04672><WTH8737> therein shall be tributaries<WH04522> unto thee, and they shall serve<WH05647><WTH8804> thee.
And if it will make no peace<WH07999><WTH8686> with thee, but will make<WH06213><WTH8804> war<WH04421> against thee, then thou shalt besiege<WH06696><WTH8804> it:

And when the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath delivered<WH05414><WTH8804> it into thine hands<WH03027>, thou shalt smite<WH05221><WTH8689> every male<WH02138> thereof with the edge<WH06310> of the sword<WH02719>:

But the women<WH0802>, and the little ones<WH02945>, and the cattle<WH0929>, and all that is in the city<WH05892>, <FI>even<Fi> all the spoil<WH07998> thereof, shalt thou take<WH0962><WTH8799> unto thyself; and thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8804> the spoil<WH07998> of thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee. <RF>take: Heb. spoil<Rf>

Thus shalt thou do<WH06213><WTH8799> unto all the cities<WH05892> <FI>which are<Fi> very<WH03966> far off<WH07350> from thee, which<WH02007> <FI>are<Fi> not of the cities<WH05892> of these nations<WH01471>.

But of the cities<WH05892> of these people<WH05971>, which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> doth give<WH05414><WTH8802> thee <FI>for<Fi> an inheritance<WH05159>, thou shalt save alive<WH02421><WTH8762> nothing that breatheth<WH05397>:

But thou shalt utterly<WH02763><WTH8687> destroy<WH02763><WTH8686> them; <FI>namely<Fi> , the Hittites<WH02850>, and the Amorites<WH0567>, the Canaanites<WH03669>, and the Perizzites<WH06522>, the Hivites<WH02340>, and the Jebusites<WH02983>; as the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee:

That they teach<WH03925><WTH8762> you not to do<WH06213><WTH8800> after all their abominations<WH08441>, which they have done<WH06213><WTH8804> unto their gods<WH0430>; so should ye sin<WH02398><WTH8804> against the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.

When thou shalt besiege<WH06696><WTH8799> a city<WH05892> a long<WH07227> time<WH03117>, in making war<WH03898><WTH8736> against it to take<WH08610><WTH8800> it, thou shalt not destroy<WH07843><WTH8686> the trees<WH06086> thereof by forcing<WH05080><WTH8800> an axe<WH01631> against them: for thou mayest eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of them, and thou shalt not cut them down<WH03772><WTH8799> (for the tree<WH06086> of the field<WH07704> <FI>is<Fi> man's<WH0120> <FI>life<Fi> ) to employ<WH0935><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi>  in the siege<WH06440><WH04692>: <RF>for the...: or, for, O man, the tree of the field is to be employed in the siege<Rf> <RF>to employ...: Heb. to go from before thee<Rf>

Only the trees<WH06086> which thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8799> that they <FI>be<Fi> not trees<WH06086> for meat<WH03978>, thou shalt destroy<WH07843><WTH8686> and cut them down<WH03772><WTH8804>; and thou shalt build<WH01129><WTH8804> bulwarks<WH04692> against the city<WH05892> that maketh<WH06213><WTH8802> war<WH04421> with thee, until it be subdued<WH03381><WTH8800>. <RF>it...: Heb. it come down<Rf><CM>
